action.onSelected: qs ipc call background setWallpaper '{{ path }}'; qs ipc call colors setColor mPrimary '{{ colorHex }}'
action.onPreview: qs ipc call background previewWallpaper '{{ path }}'; change-colortheme -c '{{ colorHex }}' quickshell niri

saveState.command: qs ipc call colors getColor mPrimary

action.onRestore: qs ipc call background previewWallpaper ''; change-colortheme -c '{{ flavor }}' quickshell niri
